active.description: Whether this integration is enabled. If disabled, no risk changes will be exported to the third-party.

reference_id.description:
A reference id that can be supplied by the client. Currently this should be set to the Access-Okta IDP ID (a UUIDv4).
https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/operations/access-identity-providers-get-an-access-identity-provider

tenant_url.description: The base url of the tenant, e.g. "https://tenant.okta.com"
